summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Motor SEO/AEO Phase 1. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests pass covering auth (login OK/wrong-pw/me), API keys list/set/delete/test (anthropic connection returns ok, latency ~1s), projects CRUD and detail, authors/topics/clusters list, articles list/detail, all public endpoints (/public/{pid}/articles with 403 on wrong key, /articles/{slug}, /rss, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, /widget.js, SSR /blog/{pid} and /blog/{pid}/{slug} with JSON-LD, /track, /lead with 400 on bad email), insights (stats, leads, prompts, visibility, costs), unauth 401. Frontend: Login error for wrong password shown correctly; valid login redirects to home with sidebar listing Huerta Viva (1 article) and Test projects. Settings page lists all 5 keys with anthropic masked (sk-e••••••••2046) and 'Funciona' badge; 'Probar conexión' returns 'Conexión correcta (1087 ms)' toast. Project tabs (Marca, Plan 30 días, Redactar en vivo, Artículos, Publicar, Resultados, Visibilidad IA, Auditoría) all load correctly under /p/{pid}/* routes with proper data (30 topics with intent badges, pillar, filters; library shows published article slug material-jardineria-urbana quality 88; publish widget snippet copy area; visibility shows Claude 100% mention pos#3; audit returns score 50 with prioritized issues; costs 0.3038$ broken down).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown (works but Starlette recommends lifespan handlers). Low priority.
CORS configured with allow_credentials=False and allow_origins=['*'] — fine for public widget, but if auth cookies are added later, revisit.
routes_main.set_key: upsert path with empty value but existing doc still unsets 'last_test' — OK but could be clearer.
routes_public.send_lead_email reports 'sin_configurar' silently when Resend missing — correctly expected per spec.

SSE article generation (POST /api/articles/generate) was NOT exercised end-to-end from UI due to 1-2 min duration; verified route exists and codepath via autopilot in server.py. Recommend main agent spot-check live writer once.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of pages render; live SSE writer flow not fully timed-executed
